[Access Controller]
I am sorry but only permitted members can enter from this point.
scripts.translation:
[门禁控制器]
抱歉，只有获准的成员才能从此处进入。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
Ah! You're the adventurer send to deliver air cleaners. You are at the right place. Come this way.
scripts.translation:
[机械师穆格奥西]
啊！你就是来送空气净化器的冒险者吧。
来对地方了，这边请。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Hey!! Where do you think you're going when we're trying to get a headcount? Get over here.
scripts.translation:
[掩体赛胡]
喂！！正清点人数呢，你想上哪儿去？
给我过来。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
Are you the Adventurer here to help us with the grape harvest? Right here!!
scripts.translation:
[生物工程师埃布里克]
你就是来帮我们采葡萄的冒险者吗？
这边，这边！！

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Touring]
Wait a minute. You cannot enter the farm right now.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程师图林]
等一下。现在不能进入农场。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Hey~ This is a time to borrow even the hands of small children. Stop goofing around and come here.
scripts.translation:
[运输主管埃农]
嘿~忙得连小孩子都得来搭把手了。
别再闲晃，快过来帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Look here?! Where are you trying to go? We have to do some tests so don't leave and wait here!!
scripts.translation:
[护士拉普拉德]
喂？！你要去哪儿？
还得做检查呢，别乱跑，在这儿等着！！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Hello? You have to deal with it before you can go? Where do you want to go!?
scripts.translation:
[护士拉普拉德]
喂？得先处理完才能走吧？
你这是想去哪儿！？
